title: Samsung FlexWash — Diagnostic code display
description: Review stored diagnostic codes (up to 7 digits) from Smart Install.

steps.title: Diagnostic information display
steps.body: From AS: press bottom-right button → CR appears. Turn jog dial CW — up to 7 stored codes display (latest first). Models without jog dial: press 3rd button from bottom-left to cycle codes.
